description:
As the 2022-23 season was drawing to a close, the Calgary Flames and Winnipeg Jets found themselves in a fierce battle for the final playoff wild card spot. In a crucial matchup between the two teams, it felt like a must-win game, and Jacob Markstrom rose to the occasion for Calgary, turning aside 34 of 35 shots. During the second period, with the Jets holding a 1-0 lead, Markstrom made a pivotal stop on Pierre-Luc Dubois' doorstep attempt just before Calgary stormed down the ice to tie the game. Later in the same period, with the score level, he showcased his skills by blocking a blistering Mark Scheifele slap shot and then diving to thwart Josh Morrissey's rebound effort. In the closing minutes of the game, with just under two minutes remaining, Markstrom preserved Calgary's two-goal lead by denying Nikolaj Ehlers on a breakaway attempt. Markstrom's exceptional performance rightfully earned him the first star of the game honors in this high-stakes matchup.
